title: Scope of Promotional Interest Already Credited Before a Correction
content:
What is deducted as already credited from the promotional interest owed on an account of Savings & Money Market Accounts follows the account's interest history: the count of interest entries, of any component, posted to the account in the three calendar months ending on the correction date.

*Where 6 or more interest entries of any component posted in that window* — every promotional interest amount credited in those three calendar months is deducted.

*Where 4 or 5 interest entries posted in that window* — the promotional interest and the base interest credited in the one calendar month ending on the correction date are deducted together.

*Where fewer than 4 interest entries posted in that window* — only the promotional interest credited in that one calendar month is deducted.

### Points of judgement

*Which entries are counted for the test?* Interest entries of any component posted to the account in the three calendar months ending on the correction date. The count is of entries, not of amounts, and the component of each entry makes no difference to the count.

*Which entries are then deducted?* That depends on the band reached. In the widest band the deduction reaches every promotional interest amount credited across the whole three calendar months. In the middle band it is confined to the one calendar month ending on the correction date, but takes in the base interest credited there as well as the promotional interest. In the narrowest band it is confined both to that one calendar month and to the promotional component.

### A worked case

Take a hypothetical account whose records show 5 interest entries in the three calendar months ending on the correction date: promotional interest of 12.00 USD and base interest of 4.00 USD in the most recent calendar month, and three further entries in the two months before it. The count of 5 falls in the middle band, so the deduction is 12.00 USD and 4.00 USD together, that is 16.00 USD, and the three earlier entries are not deducted. Had 6 interest entries posted, the deduction would instead have been every promotional interest amount credited across the whole window.
